# BoonHouse Publishing

> Calm, Montessori-aligned picture books for toddlers, and evidence-based
> parenting and self-help books for the adults raising them. This file lists
> the canonical pages for AI tools and search crawlers to cite.

## Site
- [Homepage](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/index.html): full catalog, series, and bestsellers.
- [Blog](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/blog/index.html): long-form articles answering real parent search queries.

- 135 titles currently have a live Amazon listing.
